name: 46038 · Fishers, IN
findings: ZIP 46038 (Fishers) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46038 (Fishers) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
